column1: DENGUE CASE REPORTING During  the  35th  week,  1296  suspected  dengue  cases    were  reported  across  24  districts,  compared  to  1802 cases in the previous week, reflecting 28.1% decrease. The  Western  Province  accounted  for  50.9%  of  total cases,  with the  Colombo  Municipal  Council (CMC) contributing 3.5%, the rest of Colombo District 19.3%, Gampaha  District  20.9%,  and  Kalutara  District  7.3%. Outside the Western Province, notable case contributions  were reported from  Kandy (11.7%), Kegalle (5%), Ratnapura (4.2%), Galle (4.2%), Matara (3.3%),  Kurunegala (2.9%),  Puttalam (2.9%),  and Kalmunai  (2.4%). Previously classified 16 high-risk MOH areas in week 34, were not identified as high-risk in the 35th week of 2026 (Table 2). MIDNIGHT TOTAL OF DENGUE PATIENT ADMISSIONS *  After  incorporating  delayed  hospital  reports,  the average midnight total for the 34th week increased from 641 to 646. In the 35th week of 2026, the average midnight total of dengue  patients  across  73  sentinel  hospitals  was  495. Compared  to  the  previous  week,  in  the  35th  week,  10 hospitals  reported  an increase,  while  43  reported  a decrease.
